input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 binds us (Customer) to source all hosted analytics services exclusively from Silverline for the whole term. That is an exclusivity/field-of-use restriction on the products and services we may buy or build, which the playbook does not accept, and it also contradicts Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment). The minimal fix is deletion of Section 2.2; Section 12.3's disclaimer then governs. Fallback (a single named competing product, term only, capped at 12 months, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) offered in the comment. Other Customer-side restrictions (Section 12.4 no-hire, Section 7.2 MFN) fall under other rules.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-and-exclusive provider commitment in Section 2.2: we cannot accept exclusivity or field-of-use restrictions on the services we buy or build, and the clause directly contradicts Section 12.3, under which we make no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. If Silverline needs some protection, we could discuss a narrow alternative limited to a single named competing product during the term only (maximum twelve months), with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity commitment binding Customer.
